title: Open fund-lock: nested declared-results if rotates enclosing-arm layout (#149)
mechanism: Inner if declares results:[a]; post-ENDIF adopt ROLL+DROPs stale slots by name from depths covering the whole arm stack, including slots inherited from the outer then-arm (y). Outer lowerIf reconciles by name-set and Layer-C depth only (stackMap.depth+postEndifDrops===armDepth), not mid-stack order. Outer then-path ends [..., y, a_new]; outer else (padded) keeps a at original depth. Code after OP_ENDIF assumes one layout; else path fails OP_VERIFY. EXECUTED: go(3,1,0) rejected by @bsv/sdk Spend fold-ON and fold-OFF; go(3,1,1) and go(3,0,0) accept.
consequence: Idiomatic nested if+rebind with a live sibling local produces a permanently unspendable locking script on one branch — funds locked. Shared 7-tier design.
proposed_fix: Teach lowerIf reconcile about inherited-slot rearrangement; pin NestedAdopt across 7 tiers + real Spend; un-skip suite; construct-ledger UNCOVERED row; spend-shapes family merge-nested-inherited-sibling.

title: Accept/reject oracles + shared ANF model blind to quiet wrong-state continuations
mechanism: Lean capstone proves observational accept/reject agreement, not output/state equivalence. ANF interpreter and compiler share 04-anf-lower's binding model. When both keep a stale pre-branch local, interpreter and Script agree ACCEPT while the continuation commits wrong state. Palmer-1 quiet face was this class; spend-oracle docs state the same self-poisoning path for contract.state.
consequence: Spend succeeds; on-chain state is wrong; covenant continues from poisoned values. Horizontal parity and Lean both green.
proposed_fix: Require independent expectedState (generator-side model, not ANF re-eval) for every fund-critical stateful construct; never treat accept-only differential as fund-safety complete.

title: golden-provenance intentional-spec-change is self-attesting re-stamp
repro: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('conformance/golden-provenance-allowlist.json'));print(sum(1 for e in d['entries'] if e.get('verified-against')=='intentional-spec-change'))"
mechanism: Gate accepts path+sha256+category+reason(>=8 chars)+reviewer. Of 210 entries, 45 are intentional-spec-change; 0 of 45 reason strings cite a path under spec/. Category is a prose claim, not a machine check that semantics.md/opcodes.md changed or that Spend accepted new bytes.
consequence: Incorrect codegen can be re-stamped intentional-spec-change with a reviewer tag and CI stays green.
proposed_fix: Require intentional-spec-change to attach either a non-empty diff under spec/ or a differential-oracle/real-Spend witness hash pin; reject bare prose.

title: second-implementation provenance mostly peer-tier parity, not independence
repro: python3 -c "import json;from collections import Counter;d=json.load(open('conformance/golden-provenance-allowlist.json'));print(Counter(e.get('verified-against') for e in d['entries']))"
mechanism: 144/210 allowlist entries use second-implementation. In this monorepo the second tier is a port of the same design (CLAUDE.md seven-tier sync). official-KAT is only 3 entries. Shared miscompiles (Palmer multi-local, historical SLH-DSA MGF1 order) re-stamp cleanly under this category.
consequence: Golden regeneration authorized by seven agreeing wrong compilers looks independently verified.
proposed_fix: Split second-implementation into independent-reference vs peer-tier-port; peer-tier-port alone must not authorize golden regeneration without oracle or KAT.

title: Construct ledger green while #149 layout property has no cell
mechanism: 19 constructs all carry coveredBy (UNCOVERED=0). merge-locals-nested-if is covered, but #149 is nested declared-results adopt rotating an *inherited sibling* slot (y live across outer if, not in results). That layout≠depth property is not a ledger row.
consequence: Open fund-critical defect coexists with construct-ledger CI green.
proposed_fix: Add fund-critical row merge-locals-nested-declared-results-inherited-slot status=UNCOVERED issue=#149 until fixed.

title: Palmer fund-safety bugs lack dedicated fuzz-regressions replay entries
mechanism: Corpus has 5 entries. Closest is 2026-08-06-branch-k1-empty-pad-guard-bypass (K=1 empty pad / guard bypass). No entry pins multi-local branch-merge (Palmer-1) or state-section OP_N framing (Palmer-2). Those were private reports + unit fixtures, not fuzzer-promoted regressions.
consequence: CI replay cannot re-fail when those exact failure modes regress if fixtures are later weakened.
proposed_fix: Promote minimised Palmer-1 and Palmer-2 contracts into fuzz-regressions/entries with pinned interpreter/vm/spend+state verdicts.

title: checkPreimage 760-byte OP_PUSH_TX blob is opaque .rawBytes in Lean model
mechanism: Compiler emits fixed ~760-byte OP_PUSH_TX binding as .rawBytes. Lean Stack evaluator models rawBytes as opaque data push; runtime abort behaviour is two structural axioms (runOps_checkPreimageBindingRaw_eq and statefulFull peer). Only real Script execution exercises the blob.
consequence: If either binding shim is false, a forged/mismatched preimage could be accepted (or honest spends rejected) without Lean detecting it. On-chain consequence is covenant bypass or total lock.
proposed_fix: Keep real-crypto stateful witnesses + MockProvider broadcast validation default-on as load-bearing; do not claim Lean covers preimage binding. Discharge or shrink shims when model can parse the blob.

title: crypto_call residue axiom covers all non-fragment public method bodies
mechanism: Composition layer proves named fragments; residual public bodies fall to compileSafe_observational_correct_modulo_crypto_call_codegen. If that axiom is false, any body outside the cascade can observationally disagree without a proven consume theorem.
consequence: Contracts using non-fragment shapes (most real contracts) inherit an unproven observational link for the residual path.
proposed_fix: Treat residual bodies as empirically-only; expand fragment coverage or require real Spend on residual-shape fixtures.

title: Go-only STARK/EVM primitives: differential parity vacuous; KAT strength mixed
mechanism: Four fixtures allowlist compilers:[go]. Horizontal multi-tier parity is definitionally empty. BabyBear vectors claim Plonky3 generation (upstream-ish). Merkle/Poseidon vectors are self-produced by in-repo Rust generators. SP1 FRI uses real Plonky3 proof fixtures but script execution is Environmental-skipped under -short / multi-minute.
consequence: Field arithmetic edge, domain separation, FRI transcript, or Groth16 VK bugs can ship with a single-tier golden + self-vector agreement.
proposed_fix: Label each Go-only primitive (a) official upstream KAT (b) self-vector (c) golden-only in a crypto-provenance ledger; forbid (c) for fund-critical paths; run long script-execution in a scheduled non-short job.

title: 30 of 71 conformance fixtures have no differential witness at all
repro: python3 -c "import os,glob;f=set(os.listdir('conformance/tests'));w=set(os.path.basename(p)[:-5] for p in glob.glob('conformance/witnesses/*.json'));r=set(os.path.basename(p)[:-5] for p in glob.glob('conformance/witnesses/real-crypto/*.json'));print(sorted(f-w-r),len(f-w-r))"
mechanism: Plain witnesses: 11. real-crypto: 31. Fixtures with neither: 30 including all SLH-DSA variants, WOTS, babybear*, merkle-proof, state-covenant, blake3, sha256-compress/finalize, wallets. Those rely on goldens/parity/parser-only or long Environmental script tests.
consequence: Byte-identical wrong hex across tiers (or Go-only goldens) never faces an execution oracle in CI for those names.
proposed_fix: Close or justify each of the 30 in coverage-ledger with real-crypto or documented non-fund-critical rationale.

title: docs/test-skips.md Gap footer contradicts live Gap row for #149
mechanism: Inventory row classifies OPEN nested-declared-results suite as Gap (Issue #149). Footer §Gap skips claims 'None — the audit found no gap skips.' Documented ≠ consistent.
consequence: Reviewers scanning footers miss the only fund-lock skip; inventory discipline looks complete while hiding deferred S0.
proposed_fix: Fix footer to list #149 under Gap skips; keep row until suite is un-skipped.

title: script-size baseline allows 10% growth without independent justification beyond re-stamp
mechanism: Growth tolerance 10%, shrink 50%. A miscompile that adds/removes ops within band stays green. Re-stamping baseline is a golden under provenance gate (good) but still allows intentional-spec-change prose.
consequence: Stack-map desync that inserts a few wrong opcodes may not trip size CI.
proposed_fix: For fund-critical fixtures require zero-tolerance size pin or opcode-multiset pin, not percent band.

title: External differential skips without --strict; python-bitcoinlib is pre-Genesis
mechanism: Without external reference, differential.sh exits 0 with skip message unless --strict. python-bitcoinlib lacks OP_LSHIFT/RSHIFT, large scripts (>10kB), and other BSV ops; allowlist only for named categorical fails. Harness runs locking scripts on empty stack — nearly all land unsupported at first witness pop; agreement is category/opcode-label limited.
consequence: CI can claim external differential without ever running it; even when run, silent non-coverage of NUM2BIN/SPLIT/minimal-encoding/truthiness edges.
proposed_fix: CI must use --strict with a BSV-capable reference for post-Genesis ops; document empty-stack scope so it is not cited as full semantics agreement.

title: Seven-tier shared design on 04-anf-lower/lowerIf still encodes shared misreads
mechanism: Palmer-1 fixed identically in all 7 compilers. #149 is the same architectural family (arm layout/reconcile). Ports track TS golden; parity asserts shared reading of the join/merge contract, not of spec/semantics.md.
consequence: Next join/layout bug ships 7-way green.
proposed_fix: Absolute spend-oracle + independent state model is the only non-parity detector for this class; keep it in PR CI not only nightly.

title: execute/tri-modal fuzzers remain verdict-only on stateless fragments
mechanism: execute/tri-modal compare interpreter vs ScriptVM (and Spend.validate) accept bits on stateless pure-arithmetic contracts. Explicitly cannot see wrong-state continuations or nested stateful arm-layout bugs. spend-oracle closes that for construct-biased shapes only.
consequence: Citing 'fuzzers green' without naming which mode overstates fund-safety.
proposed_fix: CI summary must label horizontal vs absolute-verdict vs spend-value oracles separately.

title: Fuzzer grammar does not reach several consensus edge shapes
mechanism: spend-shapes covers merge-k*, loops, OP_N ByteString state, multi-slot ctors. execute grammar is stateless arith/bool. No generation found for: early return inside nested if with live locals; OP_SPLIT at 0/len; OP_NUM2BIN undersized; OP_BIN2NUM non-minimal; OP_DIV/MOD negative/zero; shifts ≥ width; non-minimal values into OP_IF; addRawOutput interleaved with partial conditional state writes; #149 sibling-not-in-results nesting.
consequence: Those combinations have never been differentially fuzzed regardless of corpus size.
proposed_fix: Extend spend-shapes / execute arb with explicit families for each edge; pin #149 NestedAdopt as a required shape.

title: fold-ON allowlist empty but goldens and Lean remain fold-OFF aligned
mechanism: skip:[] today — fold-ON cross-tier parity is enforced. Goldens still fold-OFF; deployed compilers default fold-ON. Lean model aligns to fold-OFF. fold-ON allowlist can later hide divergences with a reason string only.
consequence: Proved/golden world is not the default deployed fold mode; future allowlist entries need independent checks.
proposed_fix: Keep skip empty; add fold-ON absolute spend samples for fund-critical constructs; do not cite fold-OFF goldens as proof of deployed compiler.

title: sdk-output coverage allowlist omits method-time fund paths from deploy-hex gate
mechanism: approvedOmissions includes add-raw-output, conditional-data-output-stateful, private-helper-outputs, multisig, etc., justified as deploy-locking redundant. Method-time output/state bugs are out of sdk-output's deploy-hex scope by design.
consequence: Deploy-hex cross-SDK gate does not pin method-time framing for those names; must not be cited as covering them.
proposed_fix: Pair each omission with a named method-time absolute pin (ANF parity envelope or real-crypto expectedState).

title: CORRECTNESS.md axiom headline drifts from drift-gated 71
mechanism: TRUST_MANIFEST + check-tcb-drift TARGET_AXIOMS=71 (BUG-100 +1). CORRECTNESS.md still says 70 axioms in status and TCB section. Tree has 0 sorry (rg count). Prompt's ~45 sorry/~100 axiom is outdated vs current tree.
consequence: Readers mis-count TCB; not funds-loss alone but undermines audit trust in the formal claim surface.
proposed_fix: Update CORRECTNESS.md to 71 and re-list structural axioms (crypto_call + two preimage shims + backends).

title: Frontend rejection parity has no formal or cross-tier negative matrix
repro: n/a — inventory absence: no conformance suite of invalid programs required to fail identically on all 7 tiers
mechanism: Parser-only matrix checks all 9 formats parse on all tiers. Invalid programs (non-Rúnar calls, readonly mutation, unknown ANF kinds, malformed --ir) are unit-tested per tier unevenly. A tier that accepts what TS rejects can emit a locking script for an undefined program.
consequence: Language surface is not a single reject-set; attacker/dev can compile through a permissive tier.
proposed_fix: Negative conformance pack: N invalid sources × 7 tiers must all hard-fail with classified diagnostic families.

title: Host-language map/hash iteration order is a latent non-determinism class
repro: Not executed this session — class inferred from host semantics + parity dependence
mechanism: Non-TS tiers use maps/dicts for stack maps, last-use, and ref sets. If any emission path iterates unordered maps into IR/op order, separate processes or Go map iteration can flip bytes while remaining 'valid'. Cross-tier parity catches stable divergence, not flaky single-tier order.
consequence: S2 non-determinism under CI flake or local rebuild; goldens become lottery.
proposed_fix: Determinism soak: N compiles × shuffled env × assert hex equal; ban unordered map iteration in emit paths.

title: Skip inventory documents 134 sites including deferred S0 as Gap
mechanism: audit-test-skips.py: OK — 134 sites / 66 rows, all documented. Documented ≠ justified. Vast majority Environmental (WOTS/SLH/Groth16 cost, wallet endpoint, missing fixture defensive). One Gap is fund-lock #149. Stale footer claims zero Gap.
consequence: Environmental skips can hide never-run long script paths in default CI (-short). Gap skip means known S0 is green.
proposed_fix: Scheduled non-short job for PQ/script-execution; un-skip #149 when fixed; fix Gap footer.

title: DCE liveness vs side-effecting verifies is complete for known kinds but fragile at new-kind edges
repro: python3 -c "# dce cases cover 19 ANF kinds matching union"
mechanism: hasSideEffect marks call/method_call/assert/update_prop/check_preimage/add_* as side-effecting. collectRefsFromValue covers all 19 kinds and throws UnknownANFKindError otherwise. Risk is a future ANF kind that is side-effecting but classified pure, or a call that is pure but kept (size only). Cross-tier DCE exists (TS/Go/Rust/Python/Zig/Ruby/Java).
consequence: Dropping a live verify or keeping wrong purity is S0/S1 if a kind is added incompletely — CLAUDE.md list is the checklist.
proposed_fix: Conformance mutant that adds a fake side-effecting kind and asserts all 7 DCE paths throw.

title: 03b-expand-fixed-arrays exists in all 7 tiers but has no written cross-tier contract in CLAUDE.md pipeline
mechanism: Pass is implemented everywhere and unit-tested, but project CLAUDE.md pipeline list still omits 03b and dce.ts (and anf-ec). Undocumented stages have weaker reviewer attention and no formal Lean scope.
consequence: Divergence in fixed-array expansion is less likely to be noticed as a contract break.
proposed_fix: Document 03b+DCE+anf-ec in CLAUDE.md and add fixed-array multi-format conformance fixture if missing.

title: Historical pattern: shared codegen defects reach RC via parity+self-golden (SLH-DSA, P-256)
mechanism: test-skips.md records SLH-DSA emitSLHHmsg CAT-order and FORS a=14 bugs across 5/6 param sets: self-produced goldens green, real script-execution rejected valid signatures. Same structural blindness as Palmer (shared design + no absolute execution). P-256/P-384 validation gaps similarly fixed after universal-forgery risk.
consequence: Without real execution of large scripts, PQ/EC codegen remains high residual risk despite 7-tier parity.
proposed_fix: Never allow PQ parameter sets to be golden-only; long-job script_execution must run on release candidates.

title: Envelope rejection matrix is small; pubkey-not-allowed not cross-tier fixtured
mechanism: 5 rejection reasons: missing-fields, expired, bad-json, envelope-mismatch, bad-sig. note_on_pubkey_not_allowed admits that reason cannot be tier-agnostic. 21 canonical_json vectors + 1 rejection (lone surrogate family). Hostile duplicate-key / deep-nesting host-parse differences may still diverge before canonicalJson runs.
consequence: Cross-tier signature verify can disagree on rare reasons; silent interop break for overlay apps.
proposed_fix: Expand rejection_vectors to every VerifyEnvelopeReason; add per-tier pubkey-not-allowed tests; hostile JCS matrix in differential.

title: spend-shapes nested family does not instantiate #149 sibling-layout shape
mechanism: Generator nested arms rebind all k locals in inner then/else and outer else. #149 needs a live sibling (y) that is NOT a declared result of the inner if, so adopt rotates past it. Generator never creates that combination; spend-oracle can be green while #149 lives.
consequence: The one absolute fuzzer that could catch #149 structurally cannot generate it.
proposed_fix: Add family merge-nested-inherited-sibling with k>=2 where only a subset of locals are results and others are live across the outer if.

title: Peephole/EC rules are data-driven; precondition violations are shared-port risk
mechanism: Peephole rules (and ec-rules) fire on IR shapes; incorrect precondition → wrong stack rewrite identically if all tiers share the rule table or port it. Mutation suite catches 16 curated TS mutants; not full rule space.
consequence: A bad rule can ship 7-way identical wrong hex.
proposed_fix: Property tests: for each rule, generate IR that violates precondition and assert no rewrite; metamorphic fold-off/on.

title: Layer C / result-layout checks are depth-and-declared-tops only; layout-only bugs green
repro: Read Layer C predicate stackMap.depth+postEndifDrops===armDepth; NestedAdopt still compiles
mechanism: Declared-result layout assertion checks only the top N slots match results[]. Layer C checks depth equality after counting post-ENDIF drops. Neither compares order of inherited preIfNames mid-stack. multi-result-branch-node.md §9: full layout invariant fails 37+ tests / TicTacToe regtest-proven — deliberately not landed. #149 is exactly the residual class.
consequence: Safety net that was added for the 2026-08 family structurally cannot catch the open S0.
proposed_fix: Arms-vs-arms inherited-region layout equality for declaring nested ifs, or narrower NestedAdopt-class invariant that does not fire on TicTacToe.

title: MockProvider.broadcast never registers tx in transactions map; getTransaction always misses
repro: npx vitest run audits/v1-review/grok/_probe_nested_adopt.test.ts  # stderr: Failed to fetch transaction after broadcast
mechanism: broadcast() stores rawTransactions + knownOutpoints under fakeTxid but never this.transactions.set(fakeTxid, ...). getTransaction only reads this.transactions. finalizeCall catches and warns, returning empty shell inputs/outputs.
consequence: Tests and SDK paths that re-fetch the broadcast tx see not-found; validation of post-broadcast structure is silently weakened (state still comes from ANF-side update).
proposed_fix: On successful broadcast, insert TransactionData into this.transactions (and keep knownOutpoints).

title: Upstream bsv-sdk (Rust) hashPrevouts wrong order for input_index>0
mechanism: bsv-sdk 0.1.72 Spend builds hashPrevouts as current-input-first then others; BIP-143 requires transaction order. Coincide only at input_index==0. Pin documents Go-sdk accepts same multi-input tx. Not filed upstream yet per audit doc.
consequence: Rust ScriptVM/MockProvider cannot honestly validate multi-input spends beyond index 0; false rejects of valid multi-input, or false confidence if only input 0 is tested.
proposed_fix: File upstream issue; when fixed, pin goes red and re-enable multi-input validation. Workaround: refuse conclusions for index>0 (already).

title: Rust bsv-sdk desyncs on OP_PUSH_TX (0x8d as OP_2MUL); covenants UNVALIDATABLE
repro: Read mock_broadcast_validation.rs module docs; run Rust stateful mock validation on OP_PUSH_TX contract
mechanism: bsv-sdk script parser treats Rúnar OP_PUSH_TX blob byte 0x8d as disabled OP_2MUL and aborts. Rust MockProvider counts such inputs UNVALIDATABLE, never validated — non-vacuity cannot be satisfied by the covenant input alone.
consequence: Rust fail-closed path cannot script-validate the primary fund path for stateful contracts; structure/value checks only. Multi-tier absolute oracle hole for Rust.
proposed_fix: Upstream fix or alternate BSV interpreter for Rust; until then document that Rust SDK tests do not exercise OP_PUSH_TX script truth.

title: Mutation gate: state-push-framing-vm miss on decoder-only OP_N (measured TG-007 gap)
mechanism: Mutant re-teaches decodePushData to accept OP_N as state framing. With encoder left correct, state-push-framing-vm round-trips never construct OP_N-framed blobs — mutant survives that gate. Only c28-state-strict direct deserializeState(fields,'55') catches it. Documented MEASURED GAP, not closed.
consequence: A gate named for Palmer-2 does not catch the READ face alone; future authors may drop c28 and reopen the hole.
proposed_fix: Add malformed OP_N state-section case to state-push-framing-vm; keep c28.

title: Remediation plan §9.1 open-defect table is partially stale at HEAD
repro: npx vitest run packages/runar-testing/src/__tests__/nested-loop-carried-local-vm.test.ts -t 'N22: 2x2'  # PASS; plan still says nested loops open
mechanism: Plan lists nested loops (item 6) and bigint ≥2^63 (item 7) as open. HEAD has flattenNestedLoopBodies + active VM tests (N22 PASS) and 7-tier state magnitude guards (TS/Go/Rust/Python/Zig/Ruby/Java). Item 5 EC formulas may also be fixed by integration/ec-formulas merge — not re-audited fully. Item 8 hashPrevouts still open (GK-031).
consequence: Reviewers/process trackers may chase closed work or miss that only subset of listed opens remain.
proposed_fix: Update §9.1 statuses against HEAD; keep only truly open rows (#149, hashPrevouts, residual EC/coverage).

title: Coverage ledger: 24/30 residuals crypto-witness-infeasible including all SLH-DSA variants
repro: python3 -c "import json;from collections import Counter;d=json.load(open('conformance/witnesses/coverage-ledger.json'));print(Counter(e['cause'] for e in d['entries']))"
mechanism: 30 fixtures without plain differential witness; causes: crypto-witness-infeasible 24, stateful-harness-gap 3, go-only 2, interpreter-unsupported 1. PQ/SLH/WOTS/EC-wallet entries are golden+parity or Environmental long tests, not default CI Spend.
consequence: Same structure that hid SLH-DSA MGF1 miscompile: no short-path execution oracle for the largest residual set.
